title: Level Display Optimization
description:
这个项目优化了药水与附魔的等级显示，将其显示为罗马数字。

This project optimizes the level display of potions and enchantments, and changes the display format to Roman numerals.
body:
This project optimizes the level display of potions and enchantments, and changes the display format to Roman numerals.

该项目优化了魔药和魔法的等级显示，并将显示格式更改为罗马数字。
